slides.title: UN and US envoys push de-escalation on Ethiopia

slides.text: UN Deputy Spokesman Farhan Haq said on **Nov 16** that UN envoys are engaging **Ethiopian** and regional officials on **de-escalation**.
US adviser **Massad Boulos** said on X he and Egypt's foreign minister discussed **de-escalation** in the **Horn of Africa** on **Nov 15**.
UN envoy **Guang Cong** has met Ethiopian and Eritrean officials since **late October**. Single source, not independently verified.
**Protect civilians, choose dialogue.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
